Subscribes to events raised by the Znode applications.
post.description:
This API endpoint is used to subscribe to events raised by Znode applications.

- The Znode system provides the event payload in a serialized format.
- The event payload must be deserialize before processing.
- The structure of the event payload may vary depending on the event type, so it is recommended to validate the deserialized payload 
  by defining custom models to handle these payloads before processing to ensure data integrity.

requestBody.description: A well-structured request model designed to meet Znode's standards, containing the event's data in a serialized format for efficient transmission and processing.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user performing the create. When 0 the service falls back to the JWT claim.

eventType.description: Specifies the category or topic of the event, e.g., "OrderEvent" to represent the events like "OrderCreated"

eventDataCode.description:
Code of event.
Ex. For portal type update event, the portal code will be EventDataCode.(i.e."MaxwellHardware")

eventDataId.description:
Identifier to uniquely identify the event.
Ex. For user type update event, the user id will be EventDataId.(i.e. 2)

eventName.description: Descriptive name of the specific event, "[entity][action name in past tense]", e.g., "OrderCreated"/"UserCreated"/"ProductUpdated", SetRoutingKeyFormatter(context => "NameOfEvent")

eventPayload.description: Contains the event payload, which holds the event's actual data

eventTimeStamp.description: The timestamps indicating when the event data was generated, defaults to the current UTC datetime

source.description: (Optional) The source of the event, useful for identifying where the event originated from.

traceId.description: (Optional) A trace identifier for distributed tracing, used to track events across multiple systems

userId.description:
ID of the logged in user who raised the event.
Ex. Admin user is logged in and placed the order, then his user id will be set here.(i.e. 2)
It may be defaulted or empty for the scheduled events.

responsePayload.description: Contains the event payload, which holds the event's actual data

extendedRequestPayload.description: Contains the event payload, which holds the event's actual data

webHookURL.description: WebHook URl to get called if the event is WebHook event

secretKey.description: Contains the event secret key, to be passed into webhook.

skipExecution.description: Decides if further execution of the method to be skipped.

Bearer.description: Enter your bearer token in the format: Bearer {your_token}
Bearer.name: Authorization
